panel.heading: Simulation

state.scheduled: Waiting for your edits to settle.
state.ready: This describes the circuit on screen.

panel.support: Basis states with a non-zero probability

moment.start: The state before column 0 runs — where the circuit starts.
moment.column: The state after column {{column}}, not at the end of the circuit.

noise.measuring: This circuit measures before it ends, so it has no single ideal distribution — and the noise mode compares a noisy distribution against an ideal one. Remove the measurements to compare them.

errors.too-many-qubits: This circuit has {{qubits}} qubits. The browser simulates up to {{limit}}; past that the state no longer fits in a tab.
errors.invalid-circuit: This circuit does not match the format the simulator expects.
errors.measurement-in-analytic-mode: This circuit measures before it ends, so it has no single final state. Run it in sampling mode to see the counts.
errors.no-classical-bits: Sampling reports the classical register, and this circuit declares no classical bits. Add a measurement first.
errors.unsupported-operation: The simulator cannot run one of the gates in this circuit yet.
errors.worker-unavailable: This browser could not start the simulator. Simulation runs on a separate thread, and this page failed to create one.
errors.worker-failed: The simulator stopped unexpectedly. Edit the circuit to try again.
errors.density-too-large: A density matrix for {{qubits}} qubits is past the {{limit}}-qubit ceiling of the noise mode. Sampled trajectories reach further, because they hold a statevector rather than a matrix.
errors.trajectories-too-large: A sampled noisy run re-runs the whole circuit once per shot, so at {{qubits}} qubits and {{operations}} gates this browser could afford only {{shots}} shots — below the {{limit}} a sample needs to mean anything. Shorten the circuit or use fewer qubits.
errors.noise-out-of-memory: This device could not reserve the memory the exact method needs for {{qubits}} qubits, even though it is inside the {{limit}}-qubit ceiling. Sampled trajectories need far less: they hold a statevector rather than a matrix.
errors.noise-failed: The noisy run did not finish. Everything above it describes the circuit as written and is unaffected.
